LESSON.CANDIDATE_CAPABILITY: Independent expected-output completeness and capture-boundary typing
LESSON.COUNTEREVIDENCE: No native invalidation or capture was executed; reference-calculation agreement does not prove runtime behavior or exclude shared assumptions. The capture mismatch was already noted in Contract36, so this lesson concerns independent-oracle/comparison boundaries, not a newly discovered native defect.
LESSON.OBSERVATION: Two independent retained-input calculations agree on full expected after-state wire records and identities, while the selected V3 capture path still combines a transition Snapshot with prior bundle/history. State-oracle completeness and capture-observation completeness are separate.
LESSON.ROOT_CAUSE_HYPOTHESIS: Without explicit observation-point/native-result/bundle binding types, a locally complete expected state can be mistaken for a complete end-to-end oracle. Cause and proposed capability benefit remain untested.
LESSON.VALIDATION_TEST: Give equal expected states with distinct capture stages or old/new bundles; require the verifier to reject full-oracle readiness until every native result/history/comparison field is exact. Also test two reference calculators sharing a faulty assumption.
